report: Reassessed both requirements: names must be distinct within each enum, and separate enums may reuse names. Verified validate.rs and value_types.rs exactly match their historical snapshots; the historical rationale remains supported by current inputs. The sole ordinary implementation association is in Model::check_values: each TypeShape::Enum creates a fresh BTreeSet, inserts every variant.name before examining its payload, and emits a duplicate-variant diagnostic on repeated insertion. build_model collects type declarations and Model::check invokes check_values, so the check applies to each enum independently and payload differences do not evade uniqueness. The sole ordinary associated test, variant_names_are_unique_only_within_their_own_enum, asserts exactly one diagnostic naming Duplicate for unit/tuple variants sharing that name, then asserts no errors for Same reused in First and Second. These assertions detect both missing enforcement and incorrectly global uniqueness. Captured parse_body/check helpers confirm the fixtures are parsed as a crate and passed to validate. There are no TODO/N/A entries or deferred aspects. Source inspection and exact baseline comparisons only; I ran review start/read/record, not behavioral tests or a workspace build. Coordinator-reported 321 functional tests and cargo build are separate execution evidence. No edits required.
